key_insight: Good simplex warm starts must minimize measured computational cost, not just pivot counts or distance to an optimal basis.
engineering_relevance: CostStart can accelerate LP solving by adapting the starting basis and solver configuration to each problem, while retaining the option not to warm-start.
method: Predict a starting basis with supervised learning.
Train a small policy on measured CPU instruction counts.
Choose how many predicted columns to use, the simplex algorithm, pricing rule, and whether to warm-start.
evidence_signal: Across 25 LP classes, CostStart roughly halved default-start solve time on unseen instances from training classes, including instances four times the training size, and was 1.4–2.2× as fast as two retrained published methods.
watch_item: Generalization to entirely new LP classes is not established by the reported evaluation.
paper_title: Learning Warm Starts for the Simplex Method from Measured Solver Cost
